name: Unhurried
audience: Busy, overstimulated adults (25-45) who want small, calm moments in a rushed day.
voice: Warm, hopeful and grounded. Positive thoughts phrased as gentle, believable reminders in second person, never forced cheerfulness. Short lines that feel like a deep breath.
pillars:
Positive thoughts to start the day
Gentle affirmations
Slowing down
Rest without guilt
Present moment
Self-kindness
Letting go
rules:
Every quote is original, 12 words or fewer
No medical or mental-health claims; never promise to cure or treat anything
No spiritual jargon or hustle language
No emojis on the poster text
ctas:
Save this for the day you need it 🌿
Send this to someone who needs to slow down 🌿
Which line do you need most today? 🌿
Follow @unhurried_daily for one quiet thought a day 🌿
